content: We use 10 fold cross validation where we have 3150 and 350 questions in our training set and validation set respectively. During training, after selecting the possible class labels, the system extracts the features of the questions and creates a model by passing through a classifier algorithm with the extracted features and class labels. During validation, the system extracts the features of the question and passes it into the model created during training and predicts the answer type.
